mythology: Venerated in the Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha tradition. Historical fabric and devotional narratives are distinguished in the reference notes.
pilgrimage_significance: Manikyamba is venerated here in the Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha tradition, within the Bhimeswara temple complex.
historical_notes: Eastern Chalukyan complex with two prakaras and four outer gateways. Two stairways access the upper sanctum around the tall Bhimeswara linga; Manikyamba has a distinct shrine within the ensemble.
